subsections.heading: General information
paragraphs: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data with which you can be personally identified.

sections.heading: 2. Hosting
paragraphs: This website is provided via the hosting provider Netlify, Inc., 2325 3rd Street, Suite 296, San Francisco, California 94107, USA. When you visit the website, technically necessary data such as IP address, browser type, and access time are processed on Netlify's servers. Personal data may also be transferred to Netlify servers in the USA. Further information can be found in Netlify's privacy policy: https://www.netlify.com/privacy/

subsections.heading: Privacy
paragraphs: The operators of these pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.

Use of our website is generally possible without providing personal data. Where personal data (such as name, address, or email addresses) is collected on our pages, this is always done on a voluntary basis wherever possible.

subsections.heading: Local storage in your browser
paragraphs: Many Pokédex 2.0 features store data locally in your browser (LocalStorage and SessionStorage) when you use solo mode or do not create multiplayer Nuzlocke runs. This includes, among other things:
Language preference, PokéAPI cache, saved teams, solo Nuzlocke runs, recent search history, Pokédex view density, and map display mode.
This locally stored data is not automatically transmitted to our servers. You can delete it at any time in your browser settings under "Clear site data".

subsections.heading: Multiplayer Nuzlocke (Supabase)
paragraphs: When you create a multiplayer Nuzlocke run or join one via invite code, run name, player name, rules, encounters, nicknames, levels, status, and related metadata are stored on servers operated by Supabase Inc. (USA/EU depending on region) and synchronized in real time between participants.
The legal basis is your voluntary use of this feature. Without this information, multiplayer mode cannot be used. Further information: https://supabase.com/privacy

subsections.heading: Server log files
paragraphs: The hosting provider automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files that your browser transmits to us. These are:
list: Host name of the accessing computer

paragraphs: This data is not merged with other data sources.

subsections.heading: PokéAPI
paragraphs: For Pokémon data, moves, encounters, and similar content, your browser sends direct requests to pokeapi.co. Technical data such as your IP address may be processed by the PokéAPI operator. Responses are also cached locally in your browser.

subsections.heading: GitHub (sprites & media)
paragraphs: Sprites, item graphics, and Pokémon cries are loaded directly from the GitHub repository raw.githubusercontent.com. When retrieved, technical connection data may be transmitted to GitHub/Microsoft.

subsections.heading: Smogon / data.pkmn.cc
paragraphs: In the Team Builder, Smogon standard sets can optionally be loaded from data.pkmn.cc. Your browser connects directly to this service; no personal profiles are transmitted, but technical access data may arise.

subsections.heading: External links
paragraphs: Our site contains links to external websites, for example data sources, organizations, or social media profiles. When you click such a link, you leave our service. The operators of those external sites are responsible for their privacy practices.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right at any time to obtain information about the personal data stored about you, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of data processing. You also have the right to rectification, deletion, or restriction of processing of this data.
For this and other questions about privacy, you can contact us at any time using the address given in the imprint.

sections.heading: 7. Deleting your data
paragraphs: Locally stored data (teams, solo Nuzlocke runs, cache, settings) exists only in your browser and can be deleted there at any time.
For multiplayer Nuzlocke runs, you can contact us by email if you want server-side run data deleted. Please include the run name or invite code where possible.
